copy.notice: Select a talent to read its beta tooltip, then add a point.
copy.unknownRank: The beta client stores one tooltip per talent, shown at rank 1. It does not list this rank's values separately.
copy.prereqNote: Arrow from the client's TraitEdge table.
copy.available: Available: the row's point gate and any arrow into it are met.
copy.noPrereq: No arrow leads into this talent.
copy.rulesNote: The planner starts at 51 points. A row opens once the points the client lists for it are spent in earlier rows of the same tab (0 to 30). Lines between talents are the client's arrows; the talent at the start must be at full rank.
copy.help: Keyboard: Tab to a talent, Enter to inspect, + to add, - to remove. Right-click also removes a point.
